name: Paste
description: Pastes a clipboard slot (objects, or materials in material mode) into this scene. Objects are pasted in place, on the cursor or as a stamp, as set in the Object Clipboard window; network slots bring their textures with them. Hold keys to pick the slot: none 1, Shift 2, Ctrl 3, Alt 4, Shift+Ctrl 5, Shift+Alt 6, Ctrl+Alt 7, Shift+Ctrl+Alt 8.
author: Open3DS contributors
